name: Garden of Apeiron
description: A vast uncanny region at the edge of the system where the Inspirit drifts.

timeline.summary: Kilo self-actualizes and takes a mechan body aboard the Inspirit in the Garden of Apeiron.
timeline.quote: Kilo has fully self-actualized, naming itself and moving the primary sliver of its consciousness to a single mechan body aboard its host vessel.

pages_say.description: An uncharted anomalous region between the Wurmwall and Uthros that swallows ships and appears to be moving toward Sothera.
A region where cosmic gas collides and heats before the Wurmwall; Tannuk once worked search and rescue from a station there.
A vast uncanny region at the edge of the system where the Inspirit drifts.
